tasks.label: Check build output and diff
args: Write-Output ('dist exists: ' + (Test-Path dist)); Write-Output '--- status ---'; git status --short; Write-Output '--- diff ---'; git diff -- package.json package-lock.json

tasks.label: Commit build fix
args: if exist dist (echo dist exists) else (echo dist missing) && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "Fix Vercel build permissions"

tasks.label: Copy production project assets
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'public/projects/ghayeb','public/projects/ribhi','public/projects/sanay3y' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ghayep1.png' -Destination 'public/projects/ghayeb/ghayeb1.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ghayep2.png' -Destination 'public/projects/ghayeb/ghayeb2.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ghayep3.png' -Destination 'public/projects/ghayeb/ghayeb3.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ribhi.png' -Destination 'public/projects/ribhi/ribhi.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ribhi (1).png' -Destination 'public/projects/ribhi/ribhi-1.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'ribhi (2).png' -Destination 'public/projects/ribhi/ribhi-2.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'sanay3y1 (1).png' -Destination 'public/projects/sanay3y/sanay3y-1.png' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'sanay3y1 (2).png' -Destination 'public/projects/sanay3y/sanay3y-2.png' -Force; Get-ChildItem -Recurse public/projects -File | Select-Object FullName,Length

tasks.label: Inspect remaining screenshot names
args: Get-ChildItem -File -Filter ribhi*.png | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object Name,Length; Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sanay3y*.png | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object Name,Length

tasks.label: Copy remaining production assets
args: $ribhi = @(Get-ChildItem -File -Filter ribhi*.png | Sort-Object Name); Copy-Item $ribhi[2].FullName public/projects/ribhi/ribhi.png -Force; Copy-Item $ribhi[0].FullName public/projects/ribhi/ribhi-1.png -Force; Copy-Item $ribhi[1].FullName public/projects/ribhi/ribhi-2.png -Force; $sanay3y = @(Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sanay3y*.png | Sort-Object Name); Copy-Item $sanay3y[0].FullName public/projects/sanay3y/sanay3y-1.png -Force; Copy-Item $sanay3y[1].FullName public/projects/sanay3y/sanay3y-2.png -Force; Get-ChildItem -Recurse public/projects -File | Select-Object FullName,Length

tasks.label: Remove old root project images
args: Get-ChildItem -File -Filter ghayep*.png | Remove-Item -Force; Get-ChildItem -File -Filter ribhi*.png | Remove-Item -Force; Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sanay3y*.png | Remove-Item -Force; Get-ChildItem -File | Select-Object Name
